title: Four-query circuit PCPP description
statement: For a Boolean circuit $C$ with $n$ input bits, where $n$ is nonzero, the four-query circuit PCPP description specifies a PCPP for the property that $C$ accepts its input. Its proof length is $q+2^q+2^{q^2}$, where $q=1+n+g$ and $g$ is the number of gates of $C$; its verifier makes four queries and has the circuit quadratic PCPP rejection rate.
hypotheses_covered: A Boolean circuit C with n input bits
